title: pvWriteXdmfWriter
body:
## pvWriteXdmfWriter

Explicit-export writer for XDMF 2 (.xmf): an XML description of the mesh and arrays, with large arrays stored in an HDF5 file beside it. Schemaxis writes one scheduled state per export and verifies it semantically: the file is read back and the mesh geometry and every input point and cell field must match, while block structure, point identity, connectivity order and storage type may change. Use it to hand results to XDMF-aware tools; pvWriteXdmf3Writer writes the newer XDMF 3 dialect with array selection.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Keep the .xmf file and its HDF5 companion together; the XML refers to the heavy data by file name.
- An earlier catalogue run (verification/2026-09-16-catalogue-expansion.json, writerQualification) passed only on a small serial fixture with default options; no current native acceptance check is recorded, so verify the export on representative data.

Native constructor: `XdmfWriter`. Identity: `writers/XdmfWriter`. Role: `writer`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Connect upstream object to `Input` | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":true,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `MeshStaticOverTime` | With true, ParaView writes the topology and geometry of the first time step once and lets later steps reference them. Schemaxis writes one time state per export, so that sharing never happens, but the setting still changes a single step: ParaView forces all heavy data into the HDF5 file (light-data limit 1) and stores topology and geometry as /Topology_<grid> and /Geometry_<grid> HDF5 datasets. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Output publication contract:

```json
{
  "comparison": "semantic",
  "extensions": [
    "xmf"
  ],
  "filenames": "managed output directory",
  "losses": [
    "structure",
    "point-identity",
    "connectivity-order",
    "storage-type"
  ],
  "qualification": "requires fixture",
  "time": "one scheduled state"
}
```

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "explicit exports with semantic readback",
  "outputPorts": 0,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `scenes[].exports`; writers cannot be graph nodes. The main data input is `node`; non-data ports go in `resources`.

```json
{
  "id": "exportResult",
  "node": "DATA_NODE",
  "writer": "pvWriteXdmfWriter",
  "acceptLosses": [
    "structure",
    "point-identity",
    "connectivity-order",
    "storage-type"
  ]
}
```
